---
flowchart BT
  classDef core fill:#dedaff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef supporting fill:#c6dcff,stroke:#305bab,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef generic fill:#adf0c7,stroke:#067429,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef focus stroke-width:4px,font-weight:bold
  subgraph catalog["Catalog"]
    browsing["Browsing"]:::core
    search["Search"]:::core
  end
  style catalog fill:#f7f7ff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a,stroke-width:4px,font-weight:bold
  subgraph orders["Orders"]
    checkout["Checkout"]:::core
  end
  style orders fill:#ffffff,stroke:#b0b0b0
  checkout -.-> catalog
  checkout <--> catalog
  linkStyle 0 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray:3 3
  linkStyle 1 interpolate step stroke:#d32f2f,stroke-width:2px
  %% violations: 1
  click browsing href "#focus=browsing"
  click search href "#focus=search"
  click checkout href "#focus=checkout"
